historical_native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: Outcome and value definition with named beneficiary, constraints and time horizon
historical_native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toyota's customer-first quality doctrine; Lean Thinking's value principle; later service/product critiques.
historical_native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Define value from the customer and orient production toward it.
historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Organisations can efficiently produce outputs that do not improve the beneficiary's outcome or that externalise cost.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Efficient delivery of low-value, harmful or locally beneficial work.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Name the beneficiary and desired outcome; state safety, labour, resilience and externality constraints; choose a time horizon; test whether work changes the outcome.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Multiple plausible outputs compete, resources are material, or local efficiency could displace customer/system value.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For trivial, reversible work, record a one-sentence purpose and acceptance condition rather than create a value-stream artefact.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Legitimate beneficiary representation; outcome observability; explicit non-negotiable constraints; authority to stop low-value work.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Better selection, fewer abandoned outputs, reduced proxy optimisation and clearer trade-offs.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Customer rhetoric masks managerial cost goals; one stakeholder's value harms another; short-horizon metrics; unmeasurable outcomes; retrospective rationalisation.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Lean literature specifies waste more richly than value; customer language can ignore workers, suppliers, public risk and long-term resilience.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Moved from production value and waste categories toward multi-stakeholder outcome framing, product discovery and system constraints.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use an explicit value hypothesis with beneficiary, outcome, constraints, evidence threshold, review date and abandonment rule.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: No Lean vocabulary, value workshop or value-stream map is required; the property is a decision-relevant outcome model.
historical_native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should value be aggregated when customers, workers, suppliers and public safety conflict?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target system name the beneficiary, desired outcome, constraints and time horizon rather than equating output or waste removal with value?
Can it stop or retire work when the value hypothesis fails?
Are labour, safety, resilience and external costs prevented from disappearing behind a customer-value claim?

historical_native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: End-to-end system boundary and flow/queue/handoff visibility
historical_native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: TPS material/information flow; Lean value-stream generalisation; later service/software translations.
historical_native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: See the whole path from demand through production and delivery rather than optimise isolated machines or departments.
historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Local gains create downstream queues, rework, handoff loss or delayed customer outcomes.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Local optimisation and invisible waiting across organisational boundaries.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Define the relevant path and work classes; observe arrivals, queues, processing, rework, handoffs, dependencies and outcome latency; assign end-to-end ownership.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Repeated handoffs, unexplained elapsed time, departmental optimisation or customer delay dominate processing time.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a short single-owner path, a simple trace or sampled timeline is enough; no wall-sized map.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable item identity; traceability across boundaries; truthful timestamps/states; an owner able to resolve cross-boundary causes.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduced total lead time, fewer handoff failures, better bottleneck and queue decisions.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Map theatre; stale diagrams; excessive instrumentation; forced linear path for exploratory work; omission of externalities; local teams unable to change system constraints.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Value-stream maps are frequently local snapshots and can mistake visible factory-like sequence for the real distributed causal system.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Value-stream mapping was generalised beyond factories; modern software combines traces and delivery telemetry, while discovery work may require networks rather than linear streams.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Maintain the cheapest decision-useful end-to-end model, including feedback/rework loops, queues, dependencies and outcome—not just touch time.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A value-stream map is one implementation. Event logs, service blueprints, dependency graphs or sampled traces may be stronger.
historical_native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should boundaries be chosen in multi-product, platform or ecosystem settings without creating an unmanageable total map?
historical_native_record.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: End-to-end latency, queue and handoff profile; assumes valid item identity and boundary. Over-instrumentation and forced linearisation are failure modes.

historical_native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: Workplace and work-state legibility
historical_native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: TPS visual control/5S/andon; later service and software visualisation.
historical_native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Arrange physical work so expected state, ownership, missing items and abnormalities are easy to discern.
historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Search, ambiguity and hidden state delay action or conceal abnormal work.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Undetected abnormality, lost work, excessive search and ambiguous ownership.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Expose state and limits at the point of work using labels, layout, telemetry, state models or visual cues proportional to decision need.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Work is repeatedly lost, searched for, misrouted, duplicated or left in an ambiguous state.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: When state is already obvious and low-risk, use naming conventions or a small status field; do not create ritual boards or audit scoring.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Shared state definitions; maintenance ownership; accessibility; protection against surveillance and stale displays.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Faster recognition, lower search/coordination cost, earlier abnormality detection.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: 5S audit theatre; cosmetic tidiness; information overload; stale boards; worker surveillance; local legibility hiding end-to-end state.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Evidence for exact 5S bundles is small and heterogeneous; legibility can become discipline and scoring rather than aid.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Expanded from physical workplace order to digital work-state and observability; mature form separates human legibility from metric control.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Make the minimum relevant normal/abnormal state visible to people who can act, with freshness, accessibility and ownership controls.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: 5S labels, shadow boards and kanban columns are optional; cleanliness scores are not the property.
historical_native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How much legibility improves outcomes independently of accompanying management attention remains weakly identified.

Are displays fresh, action-linked and non-punitive rather than ceremonial surveillance?

historical_native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: Conditional pull/release control and explicit WIP limits
historical_native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toyota supermarket/kanban; operations-science formalisation; software Kanban translation.
historical_native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Downstream withdrawal and explicit limits prevent premature production and excess work in process.
historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Unbounded release creates congestion, long feedback, priority churn and hidden defects.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Queue growth, overproduction, premature commitment and excessive context switching.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Set an explicit bound or release rule for active commitments; admit new work when capacity becomes available; define exceptions and service classes.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Arrival pressure exceeds completion capacity, active work accumulates, or long WIP correlates with delay/quality loss.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For low-volume work with naturally bounded commitments, use a simple finish-before-start norm or periodic capacity check.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Observable WIP boundary; stable item definitions; capacity/replenishment capability; priority and exception policy; no hidden pre-entry queue.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Shorter and more predictable lead time, clearer constraints, faster defect feedback.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Starvation; hidden backlog before entry; arbitrary limits; gaming item size/status; blocking critical long-lead work; apparent cycle-time gains through exclusion.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: A pull signal is not trustworthy demand or capacity; board-level limits can displace queues and invite metric gaming.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Pull was clarified as WIP limitation rather than cards or make-to-order; software translation retained limits but evidence shows optimal limits are contextual.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use empirical limits by work class, monitor blocked/aged work and total demand, and adapt limits with capacity, variability and service risk.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Kanban cards/boards are not required. A database rule, token, CONWIP, admission policy or finite-capacity scheduler can implement it.
historical_native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What causal evidence is sufficient to distinguish a useful limit from demand suppression or work reclassification?
historical_native_record.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: congestion and feedback reduction. Assumes a valid boundary and enough response capacity. Over-application causes starvation or displaced queues. Pair with EL-008 and EL-010.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target system explicitly limit active commitments or merely display them?
Are hidden upstream queues, work-item splitting and exception classes visible?
Does the limit trigger only where congestion is a demonstrated failure mode?

historical_native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: Batch-size economics and small reversible increments
historical_native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: TPS setup reduction and small lots; Lean product development and Continuous Delivery translation.
historical_native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Reduce lot size to shorten feedback and lower inventory once setup costs permit.
historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Large batches delay information, amplify rework and make failures expensive.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Late defect discovery, large release risk, long queue time and irreversible commitment.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Model batch benefits against setup, validation, coordination and transport costs; reduce setup first; choose a reversible economic batch.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Feedback delay or failure blast radius is material and switching/release cost can be reduced.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: If changes are already tiny or validation has a fixed high cost, keep the economic batch and improve feedback within it.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Measurable setup/release costs; modular work; validation capability; rollback/recovery; ability to integrate increments.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Faster learning, smaller failures, lower inventory and release risk.

historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Uncoordinated release creates surges, starvation, overtime and supplier amplification.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Demand/capacity mismatch, violent mix changes, uneven workloads and hidden overburden.

historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Repeatable work, measurable aggregate demand, flexible capacity and feasible mix sequencing.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For unique, exploratory or very low-volume work, use finite-capacity planning, rolling forecasts and explicit priority rather than takt ceremony.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Demand information; cross-trained/flexible resources; setup capability; exception policy; workload and ergonomic safeguards; buffers.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Smoother flow, less oscillation, clearer overload and more stable supplier/capacity planning.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: False precision; backlog or overtime used to hide variation; forced pace and work intensification; brittle high-mix schedules; supplier burden transfer.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Takt can become a coercive pace standard; conventional levelling has weak applicability in high-mix/low-volume or discovery work.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Later research narrows conventional levelling to stable/repetitive contexts and develops HMLV adaptations; resilience hybrids preserve reserves.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Level only forecastable aggregate demand, maintain capacity/time buffers and protect workload limits; treat takt as diagnostic, not a metronome.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Takt boards, heijunka boxes and fixed pitch are manufacturing implementations, not general requirements.
historical_native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Robust rules for levelling highly variable knowledge work remain unresolved; evidence is dominated by manufacturing cases.

historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For low-risk, rapidly recoverable work, keep only a small contingency and explicit recovery path.

historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Extended from mechanical stops and lights to telemetry, alerts and operator calls; mature form manages precision, severity and responder load.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Detect and signal decision-relevant abnormalities with calibrated severity, accountable response and feedback on false positives/negatives.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: An andon cord or light is optional; alerts, checks, guardrails or human escalation can implement the property.

historical_native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Jidoka, fixed-position stopping and andon response in Toyota production.

historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A recognised defect or unsafe condition continues because throughput pressure overrides containment.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Defect propagation, unsafe continuation and unmanaged emergency escalation.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Define severity-based authority to hold, stop, isolate or degrade service; summon support; specify restart/recovery criteria and appeal.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Expected propagation harm exceeds interruption and recovery cost, or safety/quality boundaries are breached.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For low-consequence reversible anomalies, flag and route to a bounded follow-up queue without stopping the whole system.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Psychological/employment safety; available responders; isolation capability; restart authority; false-stop review; recovery path.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Smaller blast radius, faster expert response, safer operation and preserved evidence.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: False stops, alarm fatigue, punitive culture, ignored calls, local stop causing larger system harm, rapid reset without diagnosis.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: A cord does not confer real authority; line pressure can suppress use, and indiscriminate stopping is costly.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: From line stop to tiered containment, circuit breakers, feature flags, quarantine and controlled degradation.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Severity-calibrated, non-punitive stop/containment authority with response time, restart criteria, evidence preservation and post-event learning.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A physical cord, red light or universal stop is not required; bounded isolation and escalation are the property.
historical_native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Direct comparative evidence on stop-authority effectiveness under real production pressure and false alarms remains limited.
historical_native_record.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Trade-off: containment reduces propagation but interrupts flow. Trigger by severity and expected loss; cheap path is flag-and-follow-up for low consequence.

historical_native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: Jidoka/autonomation: automate routine operation while reserving human exception judgement
historical_native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toyoda automatic loom and Toyota machine autonomation.
historical_native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Machines operate without constant watching and stop when an abnormality occurs so one person can oversee several.
historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Humans are consumed by routine monitoring while automation continues producing bad output.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Unattended defect propagation and wasteful human machine-watching.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Automate stable routine execution and detection; stop or hand off uncertain/abnormal cases with context to a competent human.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Routine is stable enough to automate, abnormalities are detectable, and human attention is scarce or high-value.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Keep manual work where volume is low, judgement dominates or automation cannot fail safely.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Reliable detection; safe state; human response capacity; understandable handoff; maintenance; workload monitoring.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Higher leverage of human attention, earlier containment and lower repetitive monitoring burden.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Automation bias; deskilling; opaque models; alert overload; unsafe autonomous continuation; humans left with only rare hard cases.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Automation may be justified as labour reduction and can worsen surveillance, pace or job quality; 'human touch' rhetoric is not sufficient.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Modern form resembles human-on-the-loop automation with bounded autonomy, observability and graceful degradation.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Automate only stable, testable routine work; make uncertainty and abnormality explicit; preserve human competence and safe fallback.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Toyota-style machines, andon lights or robots are not required; bounded human-machine allocation is the property.
historical_native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should organisations preserve human competence when automation makes intervention rare but consequential?

historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Define measures and sampling; examine stability and capability; distinguish common/special causes; test countermeasures over time.

historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For rare or unique work, use structured case evidence and direct tests rather than force a control chart.

historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Earlier instability detection, better causal discrimination and qualified process improvement.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Chart ritual; bad data; arbitrary limits; metric gaming; treating statistical control as fitness for use; ignoring rare catastrophic modes.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Lean accounts sometimes appropriate quality ancestry; Deming did not originate JIT or jidoka, and exact influence on A3/5 Whys is unproven.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Expanded from shop-floor control charts to reliability, experimentation and longitudinal outcome evidence.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use fit-for-purpose variation analysis and capability evidence, explicitly separating stability, customer need and risk.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A control-chart poster, Deming Prize programme or Six Sigma belt is not required.

historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Safer execution, flexible capacity, faster abnormality response and more credible local improvement.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Training as compliance; skill matrices without ability; unpaid improvement burden; multiskilling used only to cut staffing; obsolete instruction.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Participation and cross-skilling can intensify work and widen responsibility without control, pay or security.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: From job instruction and narrow shop skills toward socio-technical capability, coaching, recovery practice and knowledge continuity.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Maintain verified capability and cross-coverage for material work, paired with authority, workload protection and fair recognition.

historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Improvement solicits worker knowledge, reduces labour content or changes job design materially.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For small changes with no employment/workload effect, state that boundary and monitor cumulative effects.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Credible management commitment; financial capacity; worker representation/voice; redeployment and training; transparent gain accounting.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: More truthful problem exposure, cooperation, capability retention and lower fear.

historical_native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Managers create conditions, respond to abnormalities and support workers in solving problems.
historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Local teams are held accountable for causes created by staffing, incentives, architecture, contracts or policy.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Blame shifting, repeated local fixes, ignored escalation and transformation decay.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Assign accountable system owners; require timely response; remove cross-boundary impediments; fund capability/buffers; review whether incentives create the failure.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A problem exceeds local authority, recurs across teams or reflects structural operating conditions.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a bounded local issue, delegate action with a clear escalation threshold.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Authority over resources and policy; transparent response expectations; independent review; outcome and labour measures.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Structural causes addressed, credible stop/voice systems and sustained improvement.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Leader gemba theatre; delegation without resources; hero intervention; changing priorities; local blame; executive metrics conflict with doctrine.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Proponent accounts often make management commitment an unfalsifiable explanation for success or failure.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Shifted from supervisor response to explicit system ownership, governance and accountability for incentives and preconditions.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Leaders own the conditions they control, respond to escalations, arbitrate cross-system trade-offs and are measured on outcomes, resilience and worker effects.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Leader standard work, gemba walks and coaching kata are optional; accountable system condition ownership is the property.

historical_native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: Whole-system optimisation and proxy/metric governance
historical_native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: TPS anti-overproduction and system flow; Lean 'optimise the whole'; modern operations and software measurement.
historical_native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Subordinate local production to the needs of the downstream process and whole value stream.
historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Teams game local throughput, cycle time, defect, utilisation or productivity metrics while system outcomes deteriorate.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Local optimisation, Goodhart effects, hidden queues, quality sacrifice and worker harm.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Use a balanced causal measurement set; define system boundary and countermetrics; avoid individual competition; audit gaming and revise definitions.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Metrics affect incentives or decisions across interacting components.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a small team with direct outcome visibility, use a few narrative/quantitative checks rather than a dashboard programme.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Outcome model; stable metric definitions; cross-boundary data; qualitative challenge; no punishment for adverse signals.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Better decisions, fewer proxy pathologies and alignment of flow, quality, resilience, value and wellbeing.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Dashboard proliferation; composite-score opacity; denominator manipulation; item splitting; suppressed incidents; cross-context ranking; measurement burden.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Lean measures are frequently used for labour control; DORA and SPACE explicitly warn against single metrics and inappropriate comparisons.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: From local flow and waste measures to multidimensional system indicators, countermetrics and explicit anti-gaming governance.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Treat metrics as revisable evidence, not targets or truth; pair throughput with quality, outcome, resilience and human effects.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Obeya boards, SQDC panels, burndowns or DORA dashboards are optional; decision-valid measurement is the property.
historical_native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can metric gaming be detected before it materially distorts the work?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Do metrics represent the whole outcome or create a local target that can be gamed?
Are quality, resilience, wellbeing and hidden queues countermeasured?
Can definitions and incentives be revised when behaviour adapts to the metric?

historical_native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: Equipment, service and delivery-system reliability and maintainability
historical_native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: TPS equipment availability and preventive maintenance; TPM quality ancestry; modern reliability engineering.
historical_native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Maintain equipment capability so low-WIP flow is not repeatedly interrupted.
historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Tight flow exposes breakdowns, but exposure without reliability capability creates service failure.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Unplanned downtime, repeated emergency repair, unsafe degradation and buffer depletion.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Identify critical assets/services; monitor failure and degradation; perform risk-based preventive/predictive maintenance; design for diagnosis, repair and recovery.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Failure interrupts flow materially, has safety/quality consequences or consumes strategic buffers.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For noncritical, cheap and rapidly replaceable components, use run-to-failure with spares and a tested replacement path.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Criticality model; maintenance windows and capacity; skilled responders; spares; configuration history; feedback from incidents.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Higher availability, lower variability, safer operation and smaller required buffers.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Maintenance theatre; over-maintenance; bad predictive models; deferred maintenance to hit throughput; hidden technical debt; single-expert dependence.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Low inventory can convert ordinary failures into crises, while TPM programmes can become checklist bundles without reliability economics.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: From factory preventive maintenance to service reliability, observability, error budgets, graceful degradation and recovery engineering.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Choose maintenance and recovery policy by criticality, failure distribution, consequence and replacement economics.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: TPM pillars, maintenance boards and autonomous-maintenance checklists are optional implementations.
historical_native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should maintenance policy incorporate correlated software, cyber and supplier failures with sparse history?
historical_native_record.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Reliability reduces variability and buffer demand. Over-maintenance adds cost; under-maintenance causes disruption. Cheap path is tested run-to-failure for noncritical assets.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target identify reliability-critical equipment, services and dependencies?
Is maintenance chosen from failure and recovery economics rather than ritual frequency?
Would reducing buffers expose an unaddressed reliability defect?

historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Tier-one visibility hides common sub-tier dependencies, concentration and long recovery paths.

historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A dependency can stop a material outcome, has long recovery, opaque tiers or geographic/technical concentration.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For low-criticality, rapidly substitutable inputs, record vendor/category and test replacement rather than map the whole network.

historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Earlier disruption recognition, targeted buffers and faster alternate sourcing or redesign.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Huge stale maps; supplier confidentiality conflict; false sense of control; concentration persists despite visibility; mapping cost exceeds value.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Mapping does not itself create resilience and can shift reporting burden to small suppliers.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: From JIT synchronisation to segmented JIT/JIC, virtual dualisation, critical-stock and recoverability design.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Maintain decision-useful deep-tier visibility only for critical dependencies, coupled to buffer, alternate and recovery action.

historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Unbounded option proliferation; delayed decisions; duplicated work; superficial sets; hidden resource cost; no convergence rule.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Industrial implementation maturity and causal performance evidence remain limited; not every domain benefits.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Separated from manufacturing waste elimination and reframed as an uncertainty/option-value mechanism.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Preserve only decision-relevant alternatives until evidence changes expected regret; record eliminated options and convergence rationale.

historical_native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: Minimum or zero inventory everywhere
historical_native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toolkit caricature of JIT and low-stock Lean programmes.
historical_native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Drive inventory toward zero to expose problems and release capital.
historical_native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Excess stock can hide instability, delay feedback and consume capital.
historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: None at universal scope; the maxim creates unbuffered risk.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Remove inventory and rely on replenishment or expediting.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: NO GENERAL TRIGGER. Inventory reduction is justified only after component-specific buffer economics.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Measure criticality, lead time, obsolescence and recovery; remove only demonstrably excess stock.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Reliable replenishment; alternate capacity; bounded demand/lead-time variability; recovery capability.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Lower carrying cost and faster defect feedback within a safe operating region.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Stockouts, production/service interruption, supplier pressure, emergency freight and correlated disruption.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Toyota sources specify minimum necessary stock, not zero; empirical performance is often concave and disruption research rejects binary JIT/JIC.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Replaced by EL-008 and EL-028: segmented buffer portfolios and dependency resilience.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: NO GENERAL PROPERTY; choose inventory by total expected cost and resilience.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Kanban quantity cuts and inventory-reduction targets are not inherently beneficial.
historical_native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Optimal stock under deep uncertainty and correlated shocks remains difficult, but that uncertainty strengthens rather than weakens the rejection of zero inventory.
historical_native_record.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Over-removal shifts variability to capacity/time and creates starvation. Mature substitute: EL-008.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is inventory demonstrably excess after accounting for lead time, consequence and recovery?
Which buffer will absorb variability after inventory is removed?
Could the same benefit come from reliability or setup improvement without reducing protection?
historical_native_record.DISPOSITION_NOTE: Rejected universal rule; component-specific inventory optimisation remains valid.

historical_native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Mass-production efficiency logic and cost-cutting Lean appropriations, not a defensible TPS invariant.
historical_native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Keep labour and equipment continuously busy and remove idle capacity.

historical_native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: None at universal scope.
historical_native_record.MECHANISM: Increase load, cut staffing and fill all available capacity.
historical_native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: NO GENERAL TRIGGER. High planned utilisation may be acceptable only with low variability and cheap delay.
historical_native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Measure queues and service risk; release spare capacity only where it has no response or resilience function.
historical_native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Near-deterministic arrivals/service, low failure consequence and external buffers.
historical_native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: May lower unit cost in a narrow stable operating region.
historical_native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Nonlinear queues, burnout, no improvement/response time, brittle recovery and hidden overtime.
historical_native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Operations science shows capacity is one of the required variability buffers; labour evidence links intensification to harm.
historical_native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Rejected and replaced by queue-aware capacity plus explicit strategic slack.
historical_native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Target sustainable service and total cost, not maximum busy time.
historical_native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Utilisation dashboards, staffing-to-takt formulas and efficiency targets do not establish value.
